title: Update on Discussions for Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone
what_it_is: Update on Discussions for Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone

sections.label: Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone
sections.summary: Malaysia is deliberating the JS-SEZ's area and sectors, with an update due at the 11th Malaysia Singapore Leaders Retreat later this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The Malaysian government is separately deliberating the area and the sectors to be covered by the JS-SEZ.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: We are working towards an agreement on the SEZ and will provide an update to the 11th Malaysia Singapore Leaders Retreat that is going to be held later this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The SEZ aims to facilitate cross-border flows of goods, ease movement of people as well as strengthen the investment ecosystem in Johor.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Singapore-based companies, including small and medium enterprises (SMEs) can benefit from the increased economic connectivity and comparative advantages of both Singapore and Johor.

sections.label: Heartland Enterprise Placemaking Grant
sections.summary: The Heartland Enterprise Placemaking Grant announced in the 2024 Committee of Supply will help heartland enterprises lead placemaking efforts to encourage business growth and footfall.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: For example, the Heartland Enterprise Placemaking Grant that we announced in the 2024 Committee of Supply will help our heartland enterprises to lead placemaking efforts in the heartlands to encourage business growth and footfall.
